name: BaoBrain Analytics for WooCommerce
author: mdgaye

sections.description:
What Makes BaoBrain Different?

While traditional analytics like Google Analytics show you numbers, BaoBrain tells you WHY customers behave the way they do by combining:

  • Social Listening: Crawls Reddit, Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, Google Reviews, and Yelp to find what customers are saying about your products and niche
  • On-Site Behavioral Analytics: Tracks product performance, shopping patterns, time-of-day trends, and customer preferences
  • AI-Powered Insights: Synthesizes external feedback with internal data to give you specific, actionable recommendations

Key Features:

Customer Voice Intelligence

  • Social Listening – Monitor mentions of your brand and products across social media and review sites
  • Sentiment Analysis – AI summarizes customer feedback: what they love, what frustrates them, and emerging trends
  • Review Aggregation – Pull insights from Google, Yelp, and other review platforms in one place

On-Site Performance Analytics

  • Product Intelligence – See which products are performing, which are stagnating, and why
  • Shopping Pattern Analysis – Understand peak shopping times, browsing behavior, and purchase paths
  • Friction Detection – AI identifies where customers drop off and what’s causing hesitation
  • Behavioral Tracking – Monitor customer journeys from landing to checkout

Actionable AI Recommendations

  • Get specific suggestions like: “Customers on Reddit are complaining about sizing – add a size chart to Product X”
  • Prioritized recommendations based on revenue impact
  • Connect customer complaints to conversion opportunities

Integrations

  • Google Analytics 4 – Enhance GA4 with behavioral context and customer voice data
  • WooCommerce Native – Seamless integration with your existing store setup

Why BaoBrain?

For Small Businesses Without Enterprise Budgets
Large retailers like Target and Sephora have entire customer intelligence teams analyzing feedback and shopping behavior. BaoBrain gives you that same capability without the enterprise price tag.

Data-Backed Decisions, Not Gut Feelings
Stop guessing what customers want. Know exactly what they’re saying about your niche, what products to stock, which complaints to fix first, and where you’re losing sales.

Built for E-Commerce, Not Generic Analytics
Purpose-built for online stores – understands product pages differently than blog posts, tracks cart behavior, and focuses on conversion-driving insights.

Requirements:

  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A BaoBrain account (free tier available)

Privacy & Data Handling

What We Collect:

  • Public social media mentions (Reddit, Twitter, TikTok, Instagram)
  • Public review site feedback (Google, Yelp)
  • On-site behavioral data: page views, product views, cart events, purchase data
  • Device and browser information

What We DON’T Collect:

  • Passwords or payment information
  • Private social media posts
  • Customer personally identifiable information (unless publicly shared in reviews)

Security:

  • All data transmitted via HTTPS
  • Encrypted storage
  • GDPR compliant
  • No third-party data selling
  • Data deletion requests honored

For our full privacy policy, visit: baobrain.com/privacyPolicy

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

BaoBrain Analytics Service (app.baobrain.com)

This plugin requires a connection to the BaoBrain analytics service to function. The service provides social listening, behavioral analytics, and AI-powered insights for your WooCommerce store.

  • When the plugin is activated and connected, it loads tracking scripts from app.baobrain.com/woocommerce/tracker.js and app.baobrain.com/woocommerce/sessions.js on every page of your store’s frontend.
  • These scripts collect visitor interaction data including: page views, clicks, scrolls, cart actions, and purchase events.
  • Data is sent to app.baobrain.com in real-time as visitors browse your store.
  • The data is used to generate behavioral analytics and AI insights viewable in your BaoBrain dashboard.

Service provided by BaoBrain: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Google Analytics 4 (optional)

If you configure a GA4 property, the plugin loads Google’s gtag.js script from googletagmanager.com and sends standard analytics events to your GA4 property.

  • The script is loaded from www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js
  • Standard pageview and e-commerce events are sent to Google Analytics
  • This is only active if you configure a GA4 Measurement ID

Service provided by Google: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Support

  • Email: support@baobrain.com
  • Hours: Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm MST
  • Response Time: Less than 24 hours
  • Documentation: app.baobrain.com/installation
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from your WordPress dashboard
  2. Sign up for a free BaoBrain account at app.baobrain.com
  3. Connect your store – Plugin automatically links to your BaoBrain dashboard
  4. Configure social listening – Add your brand keywords and social handles
  5. Start tracking – Data begins flowing immediately

Within 24-48 hours, you’ll have your first AI-generated insights connecting customer feedback to your store performance.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BaoBrain account?

Yes, you’ll need a free BaoBrain account to use the plugin. Sign up at app.baobrain.com

Is there a free tier?

Yes! Our free tier includes basic social listening, limited behavioral analytics, and monthly AI insight reports.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Our tracking script is lightweight (<30KB) and loads asynchronously. It won’t affect page load times or Core Web Vitals.

How is this different from Google Analytics?

Google Analytics shows you what happened (traffic, conversions, bounce rates). BaoBrain shows you WHY it happened by connecting customer voice data with shopping behavior, then tells you what to fix.

How does social listening work?

You provide your brand name, product keywords, and social handles. Our AI crawls public posts and reviews mentioning those terms, analyzes sentiment, and surfaces actionable insights like trending complaints or feature requests.

Can I see what customers are saying before buying?

Yes! When you create a free account, you can run an initial social listening report for your niche to see the kind of insights BaoBrain provides.

Does this work with other analytics tools?

Yes! BaoBrain integrates with Google Analytics 4 and complements other analytics tools by adding the “why” layer they’re missing.

How long until I see insights?

  • On-site behavioral data: Immediate
  • Social listening results: 24-48 hours for first comprehensive report
  • AI recommendations: Updated weekly with new insights

What if I don’t have much social media presence yet?

BaoBrain still provides value by analyzing your niche broadly – monitoring competitor mentions, category trends, and common customer pain points in your industry.
